# Fyniq API

> Fyniq's public REST API (/v1) for the accounting, compliance and reporting of a Singapore company. The web app uses only this API. AI agents and MCP clients read through it and may only propose changes, which a named person approves in the web app; they never approve, pay, file or administer anything.

Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with a stable code and a fix. Writes take an Idempotency-Key and Prefer: return=preview; versioned records need If-Match; lists are cursor-paginated; money is a decimal string with its currency, never a JSON number.

## Docs

- [Agent guide](https://github.com/cognizhi/fyniq/blob/main/docs/api/agent-guide.md): how to read, how to propose, and what is never allowed
- [API reference](https://github.com/cognizhi/fyniq/blob/main/docs/api/reference.md): every operation with its permission, parameters, bodies and error codes
- [OpenAPI contract](https://github.com/cognizhi/fyniq/blob/main/contracts/openapi/fyniq.v1.yaml): OpenAPI 3.1, exactly as the API serves it at /v1/openapi.json
- [JSON Schemas](https://github.com/cognizhi/fyniq/blob/main/contracts/schemas/): one per resource (JSON Schema 2020-12)

## Operations

- `GET /v1/accounts` (listAccounts): List the chart of accounts
- `POST /v1/accounts` (createAccount): Add an account
- `GET /v1/accounts/{account_id}` (getAccount): Get an account
- `PATCH /v1/accounts/{account_id}` (updateAccount): Change an account
- `POST /v1/accounts:load-standard-chart` (loadStandardChart): Load the standard chart of accounts
- `GET /v1/announcements` (listAnnouncements): List the organisation's announcements
- `POST /v1/announcements` (publishAnnouncement): Publish a banner to the organisation
- `POST /v1/announcements/{announcement_id}/withdraw` (withdrawAnnouncement): Withdraw an announcement
- `GET /v1/approval-policies` (listApprovalPolicies): List the approval policies
- `GET /v1/approval-policies/{object_type}` (getApprovalPolicy): Get an approval policy
- `PATCH /v1/approval-policies/{object_type}` (changeApprovalPolicy): Ask to change an approval policy
- `GET /v1/approvals` (listApprovals): List the approval requests
- `GET /v1/approvals/{approval_id}` (getApproval): Get an approval request
- `POST /v1/approvals/{approval_id}/approve` (approveApproval): Approve a request
- `POST /v1/approvals/{approval_id}/challenge` (challengeApproval): Start signing a request with a passkey
- `POST /v1/approvals/{approval_id}/reject` (rejectApproval): Reject a request
- `POST /v1/approvals/{approval_id}/withdraw` (withdrawApproval): Withdraw your request
- `GET /v1/asset-disposals` (listAssetDisposals): List disposals of fixed assets
- `GET /v1/asset-disposals/{disposal_id}` (getAssetDisposal): Get a disposal of a fixed asset
- `POST /v1/asset-disposals/{disposal_id}/void` (voidAssetDisposal): Void a disposal of a fixed asset
- `POST /v1/asset-disposals/{disposal_id}/void-approval` (requestAssetDisposalVoid): Ask for approval to void a disposal of a fixed asset
- `GET /v1/auto-reconciliations` (listAutoReconciliations): List what the system reconciled
- `POST /v1/bank-changes` (createPayeeBankChange): Prepare a change of a vendor's bank details
- `GET /v1/bank-changes/{change_id}` (getPayeeBankChange): Get a change of a vendor's bank details
- `PUT /v1/bank-changes/{change_id}` (replacePayeeBankChange): Change a draft change of bank details
- `POST /v1/bank-changes/{change_id}/approval` (requestPayeeBankChangeApproval): Ask for approval of a change of bank details
- `GET /v1/bank-changes/{change_id}/evidence` (listPayeeBankChangeEvidence): List a change's evidence
- `POST /v1/bank-changes/{change_id}/evidence` (addPayeeBankChangeEvidence): Attach evidence to a change of bank details
- `GET /v1/bank-changes/{change_id}/evidence/{evidence_id}` (getPayeeBankChangeEvidence): Get a change's evidence file
- `DELETE /v1/bank-changes/{change_id}/evidence/{evidence_id}` (removePayeeBankChangeEvidence): Remove evidence from a draft change of bank details
- `POST /v1/bank-changes/{change_id}/reveal` (revealPayeeBankAccount): Reveal an account's full number
- `POST /v1/bank-imports` (importBankStatements): Import bank statements
- `GET /v1/bank-lines` (listBankLines): List bank lines
- `GET /v1/bank-lines/{line_id}` (getBankLine): Get a bank line
- `POST /v1/bank-lines/{line_id}/categorise` (categoriseBankLine): Categorise a bank line
- `POST /v1/bank-lines/{line_id}/exclude` (excludeBankLine): Exclude a bank line
- `POST /v1/bank-lines/{line_id}/keep` (keepBankLine): Keep a possible duplicate
- `POST /v1/bank-lines/{line_id}/match-bills` (matchBankLineBills): Match money out to bills
- `POST /v1/bank-lines/{line_id}/match-invoices` (matchBankLineInvoices): Match money in to invoices
- `POST /v1/bank-lines/{line_id}/match-recorded` (matchBankLineRecorded): Match a bank line to money recorded by hand
- `POST /v1/bank-lines/{line_id}/suspend` (suspendBankLine): Put a bank line in suspense
- `POST /v1/bank-lines/{line_id}/unreconcile` (unreconcileBankLine): Put a bank line back in the queue
- `POST /v1/bank-lines:auto-reconcile` (autoReconcileBankLines): Reconcile now
- `GET /v1/bank-reconciliations` (listBankReconciliations): List a period's reconciliations
- `POST /v1/bank-reconciliations` (prepareBankReconciliation): Prepare a money account's reconciliation
- `GET /v1/bank-rule-offers` (listBankRuleOffers): List the rules offered from repeated codings
- `GET /v1/bank-rules` (listBankRules): List the bank rules
- `POST /v1/bank-rules` (createBankRule): Create a bank rule
- `GET /v1/bank-rules/{rule_id}` (getBankRule): Get a bank rule
- `PUT /v1/bank-rules/{rule_id}` (replaceBankRule): Change a bank rule
- `POST /v1/bank-rules/{rule_id}/auto-apply-approval` (requestBankRuleAutoApply): Ask for approval to let a bank rule apply by itself
- `POST /v1/bank-rules:back-test` (backTestBankRule): Back-test bank rule conditions
- `GET /v1/bank-signals` (listBankSignals): List the incoming-funds signals
- `POST /v1/bank-signals/{signal_id}/dismiss` (dismissBankSignal): Dismiss an incoming-funds signal
- `GET /v1/bank-transfers` (listBankTransfers): List the transfers in transit
- `POST /v1/bank-transfers` (recordBankTransfer): Record a transfer between money accounts
- `GET /v1/bank-transfers/{transfer_id}` (getBankTransfer): Get a transfer
- `POST /v1/bank-transfers/{transfer_id}/complete` (completeBankTransfer): Complete a transfer in transit
- `POST /v1/bank-transfers/{transfer_id}/undo` (undoBankTransfer): Undo a transfer
- `GET /v1/banners` (listBanners): List the banners you see now
- `POST /v1/banners/{announcement_id}/dismiss` (dismissBanner): Dismiss a banner
- `GET /v1/bill-payments` (listBillPayments): List the payments of bills
- `POST /v1/bill-payments` (recordBillPayment): Record a payment of bills
- `GET /v1/bill-payments/{payment_id}` (getBillPayment): Get a payment of bills
- `POST /v1/bill-payments/{payment_id}/void` (voidBillPayment): Void a payment of bills
- `POST /v1/bill-payments/{payment_id}/void-approval` (requestBillPaymentVoid): Ask for approval to void a payment of bills
- `GET /v1/bill-reminders` (listBillReminders): List the bills to pay soon
- `GET /v1/bills` (listBills): List the bills
- `POST /v1/bills` (createBill): Save a draft bill
- `GET /v1/bills/{bill_id}` (getBill): Get a bill
- `PUT /v1/bills/{bill_id}` (replaceBill): Change a draft bill
- `POST /v1/bills/{bill_id}/edit` (editBill): Edit a posted bill
- `POST /v1/bills/{bill_id}/edit-approval` (requestBillEdit): Ask for approval to edit a posted bill
- `GET /v1/bills/{bill_id}/evidence` (listBillEvidence): List a bill's evidence
- `POST /v1/bills/{bill_id}/evidence` (addBillEvidence): Attach evidence to a bill
- `GET /v1/bills/{bill_id}/evidence/{evidence_id}` (getBillEvidence): Get a bill's evidence file
- `DELETE /v1/bills/{bill_id}/evidence/{evidence_id}` (removeBillEvidence): Remove evidence from a draft bill
- `POST /v1/bills/{bill_id}/payment-plan` (planBillPayment): Plan a bill's payment date
- `POST /v1/bills/{bill_id}/post` (postBill): Post a draft bill
- `POST /v1/bills/{bill_id}/post-approval` (requestBillPost): Ask for approval to post a bill
- `POST /v1/bills/{bill_id}/void` (voidBill): Void a posted bill
- `POST /v1/bills/{bill_id}/void-approval` (requestBillVoid): Ask for approval to void a bill
- `GET /v1/card-lines` (listCardLines): List the lines of your company cards
- `POST /v1/card-lines/{line_id}/complete` (completeCardLine): Complete a line of your company card
- `GET /v1/card-lines/{line_id}/evidence` (listCardLineEvidence): List the receipts of a line of your company card
- `POST /v1/card-lines/{line_id}/evidence` (addCardLineEvidence): Attach the receipt of a line of your company card
- `GET /v1/cash-advances` (listCashAdvances): List cash advances and their refunds
- `POST /v1/cash-advances` (recordCashAdvance): Record a cash advance to a member
- `GET /v1/cash-advances/{advance_id}` (getCashAdvance): Get a cash advance or its refund
- `POST /v1/cash-advances/{advance_id}/refunds` (recordCashAdvanceRefund): Record the refund of what is left of a cash advance
- `POST /v1/cash-advances/{advance_id}/void` (voidCashAdvance): Void a cash advance or its refund
- `POST /v1/cash-advances/{advance_id}/void-approval` (requestCashAdvanceVoid): Ask for approval to void a cash advance or its refund
- `GET /v1/cash-position` (getCashPosition): Get the cash position
- `GET /v1/claim-categories` (listClaimCategories): List the expense policy's categories
- `POST /v1/claim-categories` (createClaimCategory): Add a category to the expense policy
- `PUT /v1/claim-categories/{category_id}` (replaceClaimCategory): Change a category of the expense policy
- `POST /v1/claim-categories:load-starter` (loadStarterClaimCategories): Load the starter categories
- `GET /v1/claim-places` (listClaimPlaces): List your saved places
- `POST /v1/claim-places` (createClaimPlace): Save a place for your trips
- `PUT /v1/claim-places/{place_id}` (replaceClaimPlace): Change one of your saved places
- `GET /v1/claim-reimbursements` (listClaimReimbursements): List reimbursements of expense claims
- `POST /v1/claim-reimbursements` (recordClaimReimbursement): Record a reimbursement of expense claims
- `GET /v1/claim-reimbursements/{reimbursement_id}` (getClaimReimbursement): Get a reimbursement of expense claims
- `POST /v1/claim-reimbursements/{reimbursement_id}/void` (voidClaimReimbursement): Void a reimbursement of expense claims
- `POST /v1/claim-reimbursements/{reimbursement_id}/void-approval` (requestClaimReimbursementVoid): Ask for approval to void a reimbursement of expense claims
- `GET /v1/claimant-bank-changes/{change_id}` (getClaimantBankChange): Get a change of a person's bank account
- `GET /v1/claimant-bank-changes/{change_id}/evidence` (listClaimantBankChangeEvidence): List a change of a person's bank account's evidence
- `GET /v1/claimant-bank-changes/{change_id}/evidence/{evidence_id}` (getClaimantBankChangeEvidence): Get a change of a person's bank account's evidence file
- `POST /v1/claimant-bank-changes/{change_id}/reveal` (revealClaimantBankAccount): Reveal a person's account's full number
- `GET /v1/close-checklist-template` (getCloseChecklistTemplate): Get the close checklist template
- `PUT /v1/close-checklist-template` (replaceCloseChecklistTemplate): Change the close checklist template
- `GET /v1/connector-catalogue` (listConnectorCatalogue): List the connectors of this release
- `GET /v1/contacts` (listContacts): List the contacts
- `POST /v1/contacts` (createContact): Add a contact
- `GET /v1/contacts/{contact_id}` (getContact): Get a contact
- `PATCH /v1/contacts/{contact_id}` (updateContact): Change a contact
- `GET /v1/contacts/{contact_id}/bank-details` (getPayeeBankDetails): Get a vendor's bank details
- `GET /v1/contacts/{contact_id}/document-templates` (listContactDocumentTemplates): List a contact's templates
- `PUT /v1/contacts/{contact_id}/document-templates/{kind}/{document_type}` (setContactDocumentTemplate): Choose a contact's template
- `GET /v1/contacts/{contact_id}/statement` (getCustomerStatement): Work out a customer's statement
- `GET /v1/contacts/{contact_id}/withholding-decisions` (listWithholdingDecisions): List a supplier's withholding decisions
- `POST /v1/contacts/{contact_id}/withholding-decisions` (recordWithholdingDecision): Record the tax agent's withholding decision
- `POST /v1/credit-applications` (applyCredit): Apply a supplier credit to a bill
- `GET /v1/credit-applications/{application_id}` (getCreditApplication): Get a credit applied to a bill
- `POST /v1/credit-applications/{application_id}/void` (voidCreditApplication): Void a credit applied to a bill
- `POST /v1/credit-applications/{application_id}/void-approval` (requestCreditApplicationVoid): Ask for approval to void a credit applied to a bill
- `POST /v1/customer-credit-applications` (applyCustomerCredit): Apply a customer credit to an invoice
- `GET /v1/customer-credit-applications/{application_id}` (getCustomerCreditApplication): Get a credit applied to an invoice
- `POST /v1/customer-credit-applications/{application_id}/void` (voidCustomerCreditApplication): Void a credit applied to an invoice
- `POST /v1/customer-credit-applications/{application_id}/void-approval` (requestCustomerCreditApplicationVoid): Ask for approval to void a credit applied to an invoice
- `GET /v1/customer-deposits` (listCustomerDeposits): List the customer deposits
- `POST /v1/customer-deposits` (recordCustomerDeposit): Record a customer deposit
- `GET /v1/customer-deposits/{deposit_id}` (getCustomerDeposit): Get a customer deposit
- `POST /v1/customer-deposits/{deposit_id}/void` (voidCustomerDeposit): Void a customer deposit
- `POST /v1/customer-deposits/{deposit_id}/void-approval` (requestCustomerDepositVoid): Ask for approval to void a customer deposit
- `GET /v1/customer-groups` (listCustomerGroups): List the customer groups
- `POST /v1/customer-groups` (createCustomerGroup): Add a customer group
- `GET /v1/customer-groups/{customer_group_id}` (getCustomerGroup): Get a customer group
- `PUT /v1/customer-groups/{customer_group_id}` (replaceCustomerGroup): Change a customer group
- `GET /v1/customer-receipts` (listCustomerReceipts): List the customer receipts
- `POST /v1/customer-receipts` (recordCustomerReceipt): Record a customer receipt
- `GET /v1/customer-receipts/{receipt_id}` (getCustomerReceipt): Get a customer receipt
- `POST /v1/customer-receipts/{receipt_id}/void` (voidCustomerReceipt): Void a customer receipt
- `POST /v1/customer-receipts/{receipt_id}/void-approval` (requestCustomerReceiptVoid): Ask for approval to void a customer receipt
- `POST /v1/customer-refunds` (recordCustomerRefund): Record a refund to a customer
- `GET /v1/customer-refunds/{refund_id}` (getCustomerRefund): Get a refund to a customer
- `POST /v1/customer-refunds/{refund_id}/void` (voidCustomerRefund): Void a refund to a customer
- `POST /v1/customer-refunds/{refund_id}/void-approval` (requestCustomerRefundVoid): Ask for approval to void a refund to a customer
- `POST /v1/document-links/{link_id}/revoke` (revokeDocumentLink): Revoke a quote's or invoice's online link
- `GET /v1/document-template-bundle` (exportDocumentTemplates): Export templates as a bundle
- `POST /v1/document-template-bundles` (importDocumentTemplates): Import templates from a bundle
- `GET /v1/document-template-catalogue/{document_type}` (getDocumentTemplateCatalogue): Read what a template is made of
- `GET /v1/document-template-defaults` (listDocumentTemplateDefaults): List the default templates
- `PUT /v1/document-template-defaults/{kind}/{document_type}` (setDocumentTemplateDefault): Choose a default template
- `POST /v1/document-template-previews` (previewDocumentTemplate): Preview template content
- `GET /v1/document-template-resolution` (getAppliedDocumentTemplate): Find the template that applies
- `GET /v1/document-templates` (listDocumentTemplates): List document and email templates
- `POST /v1/document-templates` (createDocumentTemplate): Make a template
- `GET /v1/document-templates/{template_id}` (getDocumentTemplate): Read a template
- `PUT /v1/document-templates/{template_id}` (replaceDocumentTemplate): Save a template's draft
- `POST /v1/document-templates/{template_id}/approval` (requestDocumentTemplatePublication): Ask for approval to publish a template
- `POST /v1/document-templates/{template_id}/publish` (publishDocumentTemplate): Publish a template
- `GET /v1/document-templates/{template_id}/versions` (listDocumentTemplateVersions): List a template's versions
- `GET /v1/document-templates/{template_id}/versions/{number}` (getDocumentTemplateVersion): Read a template version
- `GET /v1/expense-claims` (listExpenseClaims): List expense claims
- `POST /v1/expense-claims` (createExpenseClaim): Save a draft expense claim
- `GET /v1/expense-claims/gst-codes` (getClaimGSTCodes): Get the GST codes for a claim's receipts
- `GET /v1/expense-claims/mileage-log` (getMileageLog): A member's mileage log for a month
- `GET /v1/expense-claims/owed` (getExpenseClaimsOwed): What the company owes its claimants
- `GET /v1/expense-claims/{claim_id}` (getExpenseClaim): Get an expense claim
- `PUT /v1/expense-claims/{claim_id}` (replaceExpenseClaim): Change a draft expense claim
- `GET /v1/expense-claims/{claim_id}/evidence` (listExpenseClaimEvidence): List a claim's receipts
- `POST /v1/expense-claims/{claim_id}/evidence` (addExpenseClaimEvidence): Attach a receipt to your claim
- `GET /v1/expense-claims/{claim_id}/evidence/{evidence_id}` (getExpenseClaimEvidence): Get a claim's receipt file
- `DELETE /v1/expense-claims/{claim_id}/evidence/{evidence_id}` (removeExpenseClaimEvidence): Remove a receipt from your draft claim
- `POST /v1/expense-claims/{claim_id}/submit` (submitExpenseClaim): Submit an expense claim for approval
- `POST /v1/expense-claims/{claim_id}/withdraw` (withdrawExpenseClaim): Withdraw a submitted expense claim
- `GET /v1/fixed-assets` (listFixedAssets): List the fixed asset register
- `POST /v1/fixed-assets` (registerFixedAsset): Register a fixed asset
- `GET /v1/fixed-assets/unregistered` (listUnregisteredAssetLines): List purchases not in the register yet
- `GET /v1/fixed-assets/{asset_id}` (getFixedAsset): Get a fixed asset
- `POST /v1/fixed-assets/{asset_id}/change` (changeFixedAsset): Change a fixed asset
- `POST /v1/fixed-assets/{asset_id}/disposals` (disposeFixedAsset): Sell or write off a fixed asset
- `POST /v1/fixed-assets/{asset_id}/void` (voidFixedAsset): Void a fixed asset registered by mistake
- `POST /v1/fixed-assets/{asset_id}/void-approval` (requestFixedAssetVoid): Ask for approval to void a fixed asset
- `GET /v1/fx/feed` (listFeedRates): List the daily feed's rates

- `GET /v1/fx/rate` (lookupFxRate): Find the rate a posting takes

- `POST /v1/fx/rates/{rate_id}/withdraw` (withdrawFxRate): Withdraw an exchange rate
- `POST /v1/fx/rates:bulk` (bulkCreateFxRates): Enter up to 250 exchange rates
- `GET /v1/installation/announcements` (listInstallationAnnouncements): List the announcements to everyone
- `POST /v1/installation/announcements` (publishInstallationAnnouncement): Publish a banner to everyone
- `POST /v1/installation/announcements/{announcement_id}/withdraw` (withdrawInstallationAnnouncement): Withdraw an announcement to everyone
- `GET /v1/installation/changes` (listInstallationChanges): List the changes waiting for a Super admin
- `POST /v1/installation/changes/{change_id}/approve` (approveInstallationChange): Approve a change to an installation connector
- `POST /v1/installation/changes/{change_id}/reject` (rejectInstallationChange): Reject a change to an installation connector
- `GET /v1/installation/connectors` (listInstallationConnectors): List the installation's connectors

- `GET /v1/installation/connectors/{connector_id}` (getInstallationConnector): Read one of the installation's connectors
- `PUT /v1/installation/connectors/{connector_id}/configuration` (configureInstallationConnector): Configure one of the installation's connectors
- `PUT /v1/installation/connectors/{connector_id}/secrets/{secret}` (setInstallationConnectorSecret): Set a secret of one of the installation's connectors
- `POST /v1/installation/connectors/{connector_id}/steps` (stepInstallationConnector): Take a step of an installation connector's lifecycle
- `POST /v1/installation/connectors/{connector_id}/test` (testInstallationConnector): Test one of the installation's connectors
- `GET /v1/invoices` (listInvoices): List the invoices

- `GET /v1/invoices/{invoice_id}` (getInvoice): Get an invoice
- `PUT /v1/invoices/{invoice_id}` (replaceInvoice): Change a draft invoice
- `GET /v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/document` (getInvoiceDocument): Render an invoice as a document
- `POST /v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/edit` (editInvoice): Edit an issued invoice
- `POST /v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/edit-approval` (requestInvoiceEdit): Ask for approval to edit an issued invoice
- `POST /v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/email` (emailInvoice): Email an invoice to the customer
- `GET /v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/evidence` (listInvoiceEvidence): List an invoice's evidence
- `POST /v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/evidence` (addInvoiceEvidence): Attach evidence to an invoice
- `GET /v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/evidence/{evidence_id}` (getInvoiceEvidence): Get an invoice's evidence file
- `DELETE /v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/evidence/{evidence_id}` (removeInvoiceEvidence): Remove evidence from a draft invoice
- `POST /v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/issue` (issueInvoice): Issue a draft invoice
- `POST /v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/issue-approval` (requestInvoiceIssue): Ask for approval to issue an invoice
- `POST /v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/void` (voidInvoice): Void an issued invoice
- `POST /v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/void-approval` (requestInvoiceVoid): Ask for approval to void an invoice

- `GET /v1/items/{item_id}` (getItem): Get an item

- `GET /v1/journals` (listJournals): List the journals

- `POST /v1/me/bank-changes/{change_id}/evidence` (addMyBankChangeEvidence): Attach evidence to a change of your bank account
- `GET /v1/me/bank-changes/{change_id}/evidence/{evidence_id}` (getMyBankChangeEvidence): Get a change of your bank account's evidence file
- `DELETE /v1/me/bank-changes/{change_id}/evidence/{evidence_id}` (removeMyBankChangeEvidence): Remove evidence from a draft change of your bank account
- `POST /v1/me/bank-changes/{change_id}/reveal` (revealMyBankAccount): Reveal your account's full number
- `POST /v1/me/bank-changes/{change_id}/withdraw` (withdrawMyBankChange): Withdraw a change of your bank account from approval
